name: The Tale of Strange
source:
Pippy Masuta, first known as Strange, was a vicious Goddess, that turned against her own peasants in a desire to destroy them and achieve the incomparable beauty. The tale took place long ago in the past. Now Strange was awoke again in a new form and ready to tell her story to the ones who forgot her and her destructive power.

[From [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/the-tale-of-strange]IndieDB[/url]]
translation:
皮皮·增田（Pippy Masuta），最初被称为斯特兰奇（Strange），是一位邪恶的女神，她背叛了自己的农民，渴望摧毁他们并获得无与伦比的美丽。故事发生在很久以前。现在斯特兰奇以一种新的形式再次醒来，准备向那些忘记她和她的破坏力的人讲述她的故事。

[来自[url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/the-tale-of-strange]IndieDB[/url]]
